messages:
nina: ran ember-7b int6 on GTN longform + checklist slices. Quick econ + quality snapshot and a proposed rollout.

rob: quick numbers pls.

bench-bot: condensed metrics:
- model: ember-7b int6 vs int8
- cost/1k: $0.0034 (int6) vs $0.0060 (int8)
- throughput: +1.6x int6
- p95 latency: +9ms on 2k context
- regressed examples on GTN checklist slice: 2.9% (n=800)

kai: what regressions look like?

nina: mainly truncated bullet lists in checklist outputs and one-off entity mislabels. Example prompt: "Extract action items from memo."
- int8: "1) add telemetry 2) run infra audit 3) schedule stakeholder sync"
- int6: "1) add telemetry 2) run audit"

rob: GTN checklist is high-value (~17% of traffic). A small truncation rate could impact UX.

kai: economics (assume 50M tokens/day):
- all-int8 = $300/day
- all-int6 = $170/day
- hybrid (83% int6, 17% int8) ~ $205/day -> saves $95/day vs all-int8

nina: rollout proposal:
1) Canary 5% GTN -> int6 with synchronous shadowing to int8.
2) Automated list-length and entity-precision checks on incoming requests.
3) 150 human spot checks first 48h.
4) Block if critical regression >2% or list-truncation anomalies >1.0%.

rob: ops items: add routing flag `ember_int6_gtn_canary`, fallback policy to int8 on error spike, and a short-lived metric dashboard for first 72h. ETA 1d.

kai: also capture prompt fingerprint + kvcache_hit_ratio so we can isolate priming effects.

nina: action items recorded. bench-bot will post the 2k eval diffs when done. Tag @oncall for 24h post-canary.

bench-bot: started 2k eval at 1871234579, will post aggregated diffs at completion.

rob: thanks. Hold final recommendation until diffs + human checks complete.
